name: COIN Series (GMT Games)
description: Asymmetric counterinsurgency board game series of 12+ titles designed by former CIA analyst Volko Ruhnke and published by GMT Games. Each title simulates 2–4 asymmetric factions—government, insurgents, external actors—with genuinely emergent strategic outcomes. Titles include Fire in the Lake (Vietnam), A Distant Plain (Afghanistan), Cuba Libre, and others. Widely used in professional military education.
general_score_metric: win rate / scenario-specific victory conditions (fraction of games won or scenario victory metrics)
reputation: widely adopted in U.S. military professional education; praised by the U.S. Army War College and Marine Corps University for counterinsurgency instruction
notes: Each title in the series uses a shared asymmetric action system with faction-specific capabilities. Bot (solo AI) systems available for solitaire play. Retail price approximately $55–85 per title. Series has influenced real-world COIN doctrine education.
